options.content:
## syfo-budstikka Dashboard

**Pipeline flow:** Kafka topic -> Inbox (ingest) -> Decision (process) -> Delivery (send to channel)

| Row | What it shows | High is... |
|-----|---------------|------------|
| **Domain Pipeline** | Messages flowing through the system: ingested, processed, dropped, delivered per channel | Processed/Delivered = good (throughput). Dropped = expected if dedup. Failed = investigate. |
| **Worker Health** | Background worker runs, failures, and iteration duration | Runs = steady heartbeat (good). Failures = 0 is ideal. Duration: low is fast, spikes = slow. |
| **Kafka Topic Health** | Consumer lag, records consumed, poll ratio | Lag increasing = falling behind (bad). Consumed rate tracks throughput. Empty poll = idle. |
| **Logs** | Error log rate and raw error lines | Fewer is better. |
| **Message Trace** | Search by event ID or reference to trace a single message through the system | Use for debugging individual messages. |

**Units:** Rates are in events/sec. Duration in seconds. Lag in number of messages.

spec.description: Percentage of inbox messages that were processed successfully (not dropped or failed). Green ≥99%, yellow ≥95%, red <95%.
spec.title: Inbox Health Ratio

spec.description: Worker iteration duration. avg = rate(sum)/rate(count), aggregates correctly across pods and shows the duration trend. max = worst iteration in the window (per worker, across pods). A rising avg or spiking max indicates slow or stuck iterations. No percentiles: worker tail-latency is not actionable today, and client-side percentiles cannot be aggregated across pods.
spec.title: Worker Duration (avg / max)
